blockers.description: Reopen evidence: Railway production, read 2026-10-05 via the Railway API: every service (api, ai-worker, events-worker, ingestion-worker, notifications-worker) has `OTEL_ENABLED=false` and no `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`; `ws` has no OTel vars. `infra/terraform/environments/production/terraform.tfvars` keeps OTel off until `otel_exporter_endpoint` is set, and it is not set. Production exports no traces, metrics or logs.

Reopen evidence: KPI `ai_worker_otel=emitting` fails (ai-worker has `OTEL_ENABLED=false`). DoD "monitoring module provisions the stack": `infra/terraform/modules/monitoring/main.tf` only computes env vars and writes a local manifest file. It provisions no backend.

To close: (1) Set `otel_exporter_endpoint` for production (the IFC-032 PR), so the module emits `OTEL_ENABLED=true` + endpoint and ai-worker traces reach the backend. Closing requires production evidence (configured endpoint, real trace ID, received alert); local, in-memory or template artifacts do not count.

notes: Governed by ADR-064 (Terraform = single source of truth). Phase 2/3 of docs/planning/infra-terraform-iac-plan.md.
